description.narrative: The Project consists of the financing of the third phase of the rehabilitation plan (Plan de Remise à Niveau Phase III, or PRN Phase III) of the Transgabonese railway in Gabon and the refinancing of part of the outstanding debt of Société dExploitation du Transgabonais (SETRAG or the Company), which operates the railway under a 40-year concession granted by the Republic of Gabon. The PRN Phase III mainly consists of (i) the upgrade of railway superstructure, (iii) the upgrade of traffic operational and safety systems and (iii) the implementation of E&S measures. The goal of the rehabilitation plan is to restore the railways design transport capacity to 16 train pairs per day. Mainly used for the transport of manganese ore destined for export, the railway is a vital artery for Gabons manganese, forestry sectors, passenger and freight transport (including basic necessities) and plays a central role in Gabons strategy to diversify its economy.

The most significant, expected project-level outcomes are the increased rail throughput in both freight and passengers, and improved quality of the railway concession services. These stakeholder effects are expected to generate economy-wide effects, including value added to the economy and indirect employment. Beyond the project outcomes, IFC anticipates that its financing will continue to sustain the competitiveness of Gabons economy by rehabilitating a key component of the nations trade infrastructure.
